title: Before PHP 8.3 an invalid DateTimeImmutable::modify returns false, while a valid modifier returns an object

ground_truth.statement: Before PHP 8.3 an invalid DateTimeImmutable::modify returns false, while a valid modifier returns an object. The guarded consumer is safe for both outcomes.

notes: Clean-room semantic contract derived from the catalog lead, not a copy of its test harness. Runtime controls distinguish successful values from rejected or absent alternatives.
